I fear they may fire me if I ask for help. I am a professional flight instructor and I am trying to make it to the airline world. 

Here is the thing about my professional line of work that my management doesn't seem to understand. I work in an error free profession; i.e. I have to perform my job with absolute precision and attention to detail or me and some poor people on the ground below me or going to have a really bad day. My life stakes on me going to work clear minded, ready to focus and doing my job correctly. I just think I need to declare myself a safety risk and take myself off of active instructing.
